decisions.reason: Conferencing is a low-investment add-on outside the announced software-defined infrastructure direction, it has not been visible since 2018, and collaboration platforms now dominate the market, so there is little sunk commitment to justify keeping it.

The metro data centre network rests on heavy owned-fibre investment, has publicly reported adoption, and sits at the core of the announced data centre and cloud direction, so commitment remains strong.
The number ordering portal is a cheap-to-maintain software platform that supports the real-time provisioning direction the firm has announced, so persisting with it is easy to justify.
Direct voice network connection uses the firm's established voice infrastructure and serves enterprise customers, and weak visibility can still be put down to the general shift in the voice market.
